sample.task:
Can you provide a Standard Abbreviations glossing of this sentence?

"The Adalatherium returns to her burrow after a successful hunt."
sample.chosen:
Here's a possible Standard Abbreviations glossing of the sentence:

The - determiner (DET)
Adalatherium - proper noun (NP)
returns - verb, present tense, third person singular (V_PRES_3S)
to - preposition (PREP)
her - possessive determiner (POSS_DET)
burrow - noun, singular (N_SG)
after - preposition (PREP)
a - indefinite article (ART)
successful - adjective (ADJ)
hunt - noun, singular (N_SG)

So the glossing would look like this:

DET NP V_PRES_3S PREP POSS_DET N_SG PREP ART ADJ N_SG

And the sentence would be:

The Adalatherium returns to her burrow after a successful hunt.

This glossing indicates the part of speech and grammatical function of each word in the sentence.

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答未提供针对句子中每个单词的‘标准语言学缩略标注’（Standard Abbreviations）。它仅提供了词汇的完整词性描述（如 'verb, present tense...'）和自定义缩写（如 V_PRES_3S），而非遵循利普斯卡（Leipzig）等通用标准的单字母或双字母缩略符（例如：DET, PROPN, VPR, PREP, POSS, N, PRT, ART, ADJ 等）。此外，对于专有名词 Adalatherium，回答使用了 NP（名词短语）而非更准确的 PROPN（专有名词），且未使用通用的古尔比格标准符号。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答未提供针对句子中每个单词的标准语言学缩略标注。标准语言学标注（如Leipzig Glossing Rules）通常使用小写且不带方括号的缩写（例如：DET, N, V, PREP），而回答使用了自定义的、带方括号的大写缩写（如[ADA], [RET]），这不符合‘标准’定义，且将专有名词作为独立词处理而非遵循常规形态句法分析习惯。
